paper_title: Tool-Star Empowering LLM-Brained Multi-Tool Reasoner via Reinforcement   Learning
caption: Performance Comparison of Tool-Star(3B) in Local and Web Search Modes

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance of Tool-Star-3B in local and web search modes across four different datasets: HotpotQA, 2Wiki, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle. The horizontal axis lists the dataset names in a fixed order, while the vertical axis represents the overall performance, ranging from 0 to 70. The chart features paired bars for each dataset, with light blue bars denoting Tool-Star-3B(Local) and dark blue bars representing Tool-Star-3B(Web). The performance values for Tool-Star-3B(Local) are approximately 50, 38, 18, and 54 for the respective datasets, while for Tool-Star-3B(Web), the values are around 49, 53, 20, and 61. The bars are grouped by dataset, allowing for a direct comparison between the local and web search modes. Notably, the performance of Tool-Star-3B(Web) is higher than Tool-Star-3B(Local) for 2Wiki and Bamboogle, while being relatively similar for HotpotQA and slightly higher for MuSiQue.
model_annotations.German: This diagram is a bar graph comparing the overall performance of Tool-Star-3B in different search modes across various tasks. The horizontal axis lists the tasks, namely HotpotQA, 2Wiki, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle, while the vertical axis represents the overall performance, ranging from 0 to 70 with an interval of 10. For each task, two bars are presented side by side, with the light blue bar representing Tool-Star-3B(Local) and the dark blue bar representing Tool-Star-3B(Web). The bars for HotpotQA are around 50 for both local and web search modes, with the web search mode performing slightly higher. For 2Wiki, the local search mode bar is at approximately 40, while the web search mode bar is around 53. MuSiQue has the lowest performance, with the local search mode bar at about 18 and the web search mode bar at around 21. Bamboogle has a local search mode bar at around 53 and a web search mode bar at approximately 61. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual highlighting of specific bars.
